questions.q: The camera is triggered through a relay: `CAM1_TYPE = 2`, `RELAY1_PIN = 58`, output 9 has `SERVO9_FUNCTION = -1`, `RELAY1_FUNCTION = 1`. What happens in flight with `DO_SET_CAM_TRIGG_DIST`?
options: Arming is refused: a relay with function 1 cannot be used for a camera
The pin does not change, but `CAM` records are logged for every "picture"
The camera shoots normally: the relay driver takes the first configured relay
The pin toggles, but the `CAM` log is not written without shutter feedback
questions.explain: `AP_Camera_Relay` calls `AP_Relay::set(FUNCTION::CAMERA, …)`, which looks for a relay with function 4. With function 1 no pin changes, yet `take_picture()` counts the trigger as done and writes `CAM`. There is no pre-arm check for this.

questions.q: `CAM1_FEEDBAK_PIN = -1`. Which picture messages will be in the log, and what does their time mean?
options: Only `TRIG`, and the time is the moment of the trigger command
`TRIG` and `CAM`, and the `CAM` time is the moment the shutter fires
Only `CAM`, and the time is the moment of the trigger command
None: without shutter feedback pictures are not logged at all
questions.explain: `log_picture()`: without a pin, `Write_Camera()` is written at the moment of the trigger; `TRIG` is written only when the pin is set, and `CAM` is then written on the edge at the pin.

questions.q: `CAM1_TRIGG_DIST = 24`, `CAM1_INTRVAL_MIN = 1.5`, ground speed 18 m/s. What is the spacing between pictures?
options: 24 m: the vehicle slows down to 16 m/s by itself
48 m: every second trigger is skipped by the driver
24 m: the interval limits only a manual trigger
27 m: the trigger waits 1.5 s, the vehicle does not slow down
questions.explain: When the interval has not elapsed, `take_picture()` sets `trigger_pending` and takes the picture as soon as the 1.5 s are up: the spacing is 18 · 1.5 = 27 m. 48 m would be the result of `CAM1_INTRVAL_MIN = 0` and a camera that misses a trigger.

questions.q: Servo gimbal: `MNT1_PITCH_MIN = -90`, `MNT1_PITCH_MAX = 20`, `SERVO8_MIN = 1100`, `SERVO8_MAX = 1900`, `SERVO8_TRIM = 1500`. What is the pulse at a pitch of 0°?
questions.explain: `move_servo`: v = (0 − (−900)) / 1100 = 0.818; 1100 + ⌊0.818 · 800⌋ = 1100 + 654 = 1754. TRIM is not in the formula; 1755 is rounding instead of truncation.

questions.q: A brushless gimbal with its own controller and a PWM input per axis. Which `MNT1_TYPE` do you choose?
options: 1, Servo, so that the flight controller adds its stabilization
7, BrushlessPWM: the flight controller sets the angle and does not subtract the tilt
8, Siyi: it is the general type for gimbals with a controller
6, MAVLink: PWM gimbals are polled over MAVLink by the firmware
questions.explain: Type 7 creates `AP_Mount_Servo` with `requires_stabilization = false`. Type 1 would subtract the vehicle attitude on top of the gimbal's own stabilization, doubling the compensation.

questions.q: A Siyi on `SERIAL2`. Which set of parameters is needed?
options: `SERIAL2_PROTOCOL = 2`, `MNT1_TYPE = 6`, `CAM1_TYPE = 6`
`SERIAL2_PROTOCOL = 7`, `MNT1_TYPE = 8`, `CAM1_TYPE = 5`
`SERIAL2_PROTOCOL = 8`, `MNT1_TYPE = 8`, `CAM1_TYPE = 4`
`SERIAL2_PROTOCOL = 8`, `MNT1_TYPE = 5`, `CAM1_TYPE = 1`
questions.explain: Siyi is a driver on a serial port with protocol 8 (Gimbal, 115200 is set automatically), mount type 8; the camera inside the gimbal is triggered through the gimbal driver, `CAM1_TYPE = 4`. Protocol 7 is Alexmos only, and type 5 is SToRM32 Serial.

questions.q: The gripper is a servo with a pin, but the parameters have `GRIP_TYPE = 2`. What happens after a "grab" command?
options: After 0.5 s the output returns to `GRIP_NEUTRAL`
Nothing: type 2 works only over CAN
The servo goes to `GRIP_GRAB` and stays there
Arming is refused until the type is corrected
questions.explain: The EPM driver gives a pulse and after `EPM_RETURN_TO_NEUTRAL_MS` = 500 ms sets `GRIP_NEUTRAL` (1500): the servo goes to the middle position. The CAN branch is not built in 4.7.2.

questions.q: Copter 4.7.2, a board with a safety switch, motors on outputs 1–4, `BRD_SAFETY_MASK` was never set. The gripper servo is on output 7, a relay is on the GPIO pin of output 9. What works while the safety is on?
options: Nothing: the safety holds all outputs until the switch is pressed
Only the relay: GPIO pins are not checked against the safety state
Only the gripper: output 7 is in the default mask
Both the gripper and the relay
questions.explain: The Copter default is all non-motor outputs 1–14 (16368), so the bit of output 7 is set. A write to a GPIO pin bypasses the safety. To hold the gripper you have to write a mask without bit 64.

questions.q: Mission: `NAV_WAYPOINT` (the release point) → `DO_GRIPPER` → `CONDITION_DELAY` 2 s → `DO_DIGICAM_CONTROL` → `NAV_RETURN_TO_LAUNCH`. What executes at the point?
options: Everything: DO commands run before the next navigation command starts
The release; the picture only if RTL lasts longer than 2 s
Nothing: DO commands have to be placed before `NAV_WAYPOINT`
The picture, while the release is postponed until landing
questions.explain: DO commands between two navigation commands start together with the second one (RTL here) and execute while it is running. `DO_GRIPPER` runs at once and the picture after the 2 s delay, but by then the vehicle is already flying home; if RTL completes earlier, the remainder is discarded. That is why the module puts `NAV_LOITER_TIME` after the DO commands.

questions.q: The transmitter was turned on while the `RC7_OPTION = 19` switch was in the low position, and the payload was already hung. What does Copter 4.7.2 do?
options: Nothing: the position on the first frame is only stored
It opens the gripper on the first receiver frame
It opens the gripper only after arming
It refuses to arm with a message about the switch position
questions.explain: `init_position_on_first_radio_read` returns true only for arming and parachute release. For the gripper the first position read is executed: LOW is `gripper.release()`.
